paper_title: New solar X-ray constraints on keV Axion-Like Particles
notes: Paper presents new solar X-ray constraints on keV-scale ALPs using SphinX (1.5–6 keV) and NuSTAR (3–20 keV) data. Main improvement is inclusion of photon coalescence production mechanism (improves limits by ~1 order of magnitude over prior work) and Compton absorption of trapped ALPs. Figure 1 shows exclusion limits in (g_agamma, m) plane for hadronic axions (g_ae = 0). Figure 4 shows limits for various g_ae values. Data points extracted from Figure 1 (combined SphinX+NuSTAR with coalescence) represent approximate boundary of excluded region. The limits are mass-dependent and derived from solar X-ray flux measurements without assuming ALPs comprise all dark matter. Confidence in extraction is moderate (0.75) because exact numerical values are read from plots rather than provided in tables; however, the coupling type (AxionPhoton via g_agamma) and mass range (3–40 keV) are unambiguous from title, abstract, and figures. | selector: text (sole candidate)
